proof: COVERAGE, not arithmetic: `2019 CALENDAR YEAR WAGES`, PDF pages 197-203 of the FY2019 annual town report (printed folios 195-201), prints NO TOTAL anywhere -- no page total, no grand total, no subtotal -- so nothing here can be footed and A MISREAD DIGIT WOULD SURVIVE EVERY ASSERTION IN THIS FILE UNTOUCHED. 599 names are printed across the seven pages: 94 on each of pages 197-202 and 35 on page 203. THE PAGE IS ONE TABLE OF SEVEN COLUMNS, NOT TWO TABLES -- surname, first name, amount, a narrow EMPTY ruled column, then surname, first name, amount again -- and the two halves are ONE CONTINUOUS A-Z SEQUENCE, read down the LEFT three columns of a page and then down the RIGHT three: ABARE-BIENVENU, BIERY-CAMPBELL, CANTATORE-CORRIGAN, COTE-FAIOLA, FARRAR-GRIGAS, GROTE-KLAFT, KLINGAMAN-MACDOUGALL, MACKINNON-MCGUIGAN, MCGUIRE-NYGREN, OKERMAN-RENZI, RHODES-SHORT, SICARD-TSIAKALOS, TYLER-ZRATE. Every one of the twelve panel boundaries carries on alphabetically, which is the evidence for reading it as one list rather than as the two independent A-Z lists FY2020 and FY2022 print; those years are transcribed as `-column-a`/`-column-b` for that reason and this year is not. Each page opens with one centred title `2019 CALENDAR YEAR WAGES` ABOVE the ruled box, with white space between: there is NO column header row and NO row hidden under the header -- settled by stacking the title band and the first two rows of all seven pages into one image and reading it, not inferred. Pages 196 and 204 were walked too: 196 is the election result and vital records page and 204 is BLANK but for its folio, so the run neither starts earlier nor ends later. Every page is a PHOTOGRAPH (0 words of text layer on all 206 pages of this report) carrying ONE embedded JBIG2 bitmap at 4400x3400, 400 dpi -- the best resolution in this archive -- and was read from the stored bitmap rather than from a render, so no canvas could be sized for one geometry and drawn with another. WHAT IS ASSERTED IS THE SHAPE: 94 rows on every page but the last, exactly one money figure per row (599 of 599 rows parse as one amount with cents), and the surname sequence never going backwards -- 0 backward steps in 599 rows, on the TOWN'S OWN SORT, where a space sorts before a letter so `ST JEAN` precedes `STADLER`. A SECOND INSTRUMENT WAS RUN AGAINST THE SAME SEVEN PAGES: the recognition reading in `gross-wages.csv` holds 516 rows for them, and ALL 516 are accounted for by this reading -- 509 matched by name and 7 more by amount alone because recognition mangled the name (BERRYR CATHLEEN, BETTI LINDAR, BLANCHETTE LERIN, BUTEAU WEIGOLOJOYCE, DANCE IROBIN, DUSEK JAYNER, MCKENZIER LAURA). 516 of 516 amounts agree to THE CENT: 516 agreements, 0 disagreements. The 83 rows this reading holds that recognition does not are whole names it dropped, 65 of them on page 200 alone, which is why that page shows 29 rows there and 94 here. `report-gross-wages.csv` holds only 42 rows for this run, all on page 199, and nothing for the other six pages. ROW ALIGNMENT BETWEEN THE TWO HALVES IS CHECKED INDEPENDENTLY of the transcription, because an off-by-one between the halves is the error a two-panel page makes most easily: the column rules print solid on page 197 and were measured there as fractions of the table's own width (0, .235, .394, .506, .554, .719, .887, 1), the row grid was laid on each page as a uniform pitch between that page's measured table top and bottom, and the ink in every cell was counted. On pages 197-202 all 282 row bands carry ink in all SIX content columns -- 1,692 of 1,692 cells occupied, 0 rows short -- so the left name and the right amount of a row are the same printed row. The narrow fourth column is empty on page 197, the page whose rules print cleanly. That rules out an off-by-one in either half; IT SAYS NOTHING ABOUT ANY INDIVIDUAL DIGIT. PAGE 203 PRINTS 35 NAMES IN ITS LEFT HALF AND AN EMPTY RULED GRID OF 35 ROWS IN ITS RIGHT -- the page prints the grid and no names in it, read at full resolution, exactly as FY2021's last wage page does. Five names are printed TRUNCATED by their own column rule and are recorded as printed: p197 `BUTEAU WEIGOLD`, p198 `DIAMANTOPOULC`, p200 `MARTINEZ-NIEME` and `MCCARTHY-GUILL`, p201 `PETERSON-BLANK` (FY2020 prints the same person as `PETERSON-BLANKENSI` and FY2021 as `PETERSON-BLANKEN`) and `PUNALES-SANTIAG`.
